clues: This city stands on the west coast of Sumatra, a big island in the far west of Indonesia. It is the largest city on that coast.
This is one of the wettest cities in its country, and rain falls all through the year. Big spinning storms are very rare this close to the equator.
In 1906 this town won full city status. It and one other town were the first in Sumatra to earn that rank.
This place is famed far and wide for its local food. Its beaches, too, are loved for the bright sunsets seen from the shore.
This town is the chief town of West Sumatra. All the leaders of that part of Indonesia work and rule from here.
